name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-businesscentral
title: Businesscentral
description: Unofficial MCP server for Dynamics 365 Business Central: reads and opt-in everyday changes.

environmentVariables.name: BC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the Dynamics 365 Business Central API.

environmentVariables.name: BC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Dynamics 365 Business Central API.

environmentVariables.name: BC_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow the change tools (create, update, post, send, delete a draft). Default false.

environmentVariables.name: BC_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
